svg.metadata: {"id": "s036", "name": "分数披萨店", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "分数", "平均分", "生活"], "desc": "温暖的披萨店：柜台上的披萨被精确切成 2、4、8 等份（拿走一块），黑板菜单画着分数饼图，右侧砖砌烤炉火光闪烁。", "stand": {"ground_y": 920, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "awning", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "menu", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "peel", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "oven", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "fire", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "counter", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pizzas", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "counter_props", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.75, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamps", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "steam", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#FFF1E2", "wall2": "#F8DEC4", "tile": "#F1D2B4", "awn1": "#E3584A", "awn2": "#FFFFFF", "board": "#34433F", "board2": "#2A3734", "frame": "#B9804E", "chalk": "#FFFFFF", "chalky": "#FFE08A", "counter": "#3F7F6E", "counter2": "#326656", "top": "#F4EDE2", "crust": "#E9A55A", "crust2": "#C9823D", "sauce": "#D9483B", "cheese": "#FFD66B", "cheese2": "#FFE79A", "pep": "#C2392F", "basil": "#4E9E5A", "brick": "#C8674A", "brick2": "#A9533B", "fire": "#FF9F43", "fire2": "#FFD36E", "plate": "#FFFFFF", "wood": "#C58A55", "wood2": "#9C6537", "floor1": "#F2E6D6", "floor2": "#3F4A55", "lamp": "#FFE3A3", "leaf": "#6DB585", "leaf2": "#A6D99A"}}
